$Comment: The Winter Bauble find (Christmas_Bauble_Find.json) on a server running MMO Skill Tree, where a
woodcutter's luck makes it come more often. The file name is the row's id.
It claims the same moment and the same pattern as the plain find (When BreakBlock, Match *_Trunk), and
two rows claiming one pattern in one moment are one answer: the row whose id sorts last wins, and
Mmo_Christmas_Bauble_Find sorts after Christmas_Bauble_Find. So with MMO Skill Tree this row takes the
plain row's place, the same find with the same sound. Requires, the plain hytale:mod_installed condition
with Min 1, drops this file at load where that mod is missing, and the plain row runs at its flat
chance there. Season leaves it out while Christmas is off, as the plain row's does.
Chance is a percent: the plain row's 5 as its Base, plus the breaker's Woodcutting luck
(MMO_Luck_WOODCUTTING, which the Christmas Set's MMO half raises) and their luck for everything
(MMO_Luck), both read through hytale:stat in whole points. Clamp holds it at 25 at most. Keep the Base
equal to the plain row's Chance, so a player with no luck finds baubles as often on both servers. A
server owner retunes or switches off this row by its own id in mods/ziggfreedcommon/bonus-rows.json;
switching off the plain row alone leaves this one running where MMO Skill Tree is installed.
